units: <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 22:6">Midr. Prov. ch. XXII</cite>; a. fr.—<he>בד׳</he> in poverty, i.e. sacrifice of poverty (birds), opp. <he>בעשירות</he> lambs, goats &c.; <he>בדַלֵּי ד׳</he> the sacrifice of extreme poverty (flour).
Hor. 9ᵃ (v. Ms. M. a. l.). Kerith. l. c. עֲלֵיה דְדַלּוּת upon the person coming under the category of dalluth; עליה דדלי דלות upon the person coming under the category of extreme dalluth.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 2:6:2">Y. Hor. II, 46ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 14:21">Lev. XIV, 21</cite>) <he>מי שהוא ראוי לבוא לידי ד׳</he> only he who may possibly come under the category &c. (Bab.

<cite ref="Yoma 9b">Yoma 9ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="D00864"><he>דלת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 8:9">Cant. VIII, 9</cite>) <he>שעליתם בד׳</he> (Ms. M. 2) that ye left the Babylonian captivity with vacillation, opp. to <he>כחומה</he>, ‘as a wall’, i.e. all combined and firm; (Ms. Ms. 1 <he>שעשיתם עצמיכם כדלת</he>, ed. <he>שעליתם כדלתות</he>; Ar. ed. pr. s. v. <he>סממגור</he> quotes <he>בדַלְדַּלּוּת</he>, Ms. Koh. <he>בדלי דלות</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 994">Yalk. Cant. 994</cite> Ms. <he>בדלי דלות</he>).
